CENSUS 2026-09-07, and it is the finding this ticket now stands on: 10 records.jsonl on disk holding 1,817 records — harbor_master 1429, librarian 156, codemother 59, charter 46, press_office 40, cairn 32, tester 31, disk_only 12, test_no_verb_device 9, inference_domain 3. Exactly 2 construction sites (cairn/tools/base/device.py:240, cairn/devices/cairn/machines/ground_loop/discovered.py:103) and ZERO readers: nothing in the corpus calls .read() or .clear() on a recorder outside that recorder's own proofs. Every one is BaseDevice.receive()'s default sink for verbless mail — mail arrives, is recorded 'for later evaluation', and nothing evaluates. This CONFIRMS the why rather than killing the ticket ('data written for a reader who never comes, discovered by accident'), and it prices the design: undeclared-is-red fires on all ten the first beat after this lands, which under the trouble damper is ten tickets at count 1 — the improvement backlog doing its job, not a flood.
